title: GAMEBoT: Transparent Assessment of LLM Reasoning in Games

live_model.evidence: Appendix A: 'GPT-4o: gpt-4o-2024-05-13'; Table 2 benchmarking results, row GPT-4o, Avg. 0.47

prompt.location: Appendix H 'Full Prompts' (per game, e.g. H.1 Othello)

claim.metric: average of outcome and intermediate-step scores

data.source: Game states generated by the GAMEBoT framework (visual-ai.github.io/gamebot); opponents are other LLMs

notes: Inputs are live game states from head-to-head play; opponents include retired models (gpt-4-1106, Gemini-Pro, Claude 3 Sonnet/Haiku, Reka). Not re-runnable without the environment code. data_closed is used here to mean environment-generated inputs. o3-mini-high appears only in a supplementary Connect4 competition.
